headlines.description: — Otto López homered, Xavier Edwards had an RBI single in the fifth and the Miami Marlins beat the Texas Rangers 4-2 on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Otto López homers, has another multi-hit game and Marlins beat Rangers 4-2

events.name: Chicago Cubs at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Dansby Swanson hit a tiebreaking three-run homer in the sixth inning and added a grand slam in the eighth inning Wednesday, lifting the Chicago Cubs to a 10-3 win over the reeling New York Mets in the opener of a day-night doubleheader.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dansby Swanson has 2 homers, 7 RBIs as Cubs pound Mets 10-3 in Game 1

events.name: Cleveland Guardians at Chicago White Sox
Boston Red Sox at Colorado Rockies

headlines.description: — Tyler Freeman's sacrifice bunt in the eighth inning drove in the go-ahead run, Cole Carrigg had three RBI and the Colorado Rockies rallied past the Boston Red Sox 8-6 on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Freeman's bunt drives in go-ahead run, Carrigg has 3 RBIs as Rockies rally past Red Sox 8-6

events.name: Baltimore Orioles at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — Nolan Schanuel reached third on an error and Logan O'Hoppe drove him in on a soft ground ball in the 10th inning as the Los Angeles Angels rallied back to defeat the Baltimore Orioles 7-6 on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: O'Hoppe's 10th inning single drives in winning run as Angels rally over Orioles 7-6

events.name: Kansas City Royals at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Griffin Jax pitched five strong innings, Yandy Díaz tied Tampa Bay's franchise record for career RBI and the Rays defeated the Kansas City Royals 5-3 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jax shines as Díaz ties Rays' RBIs record in 5-3 win over Royals

events.name: New York Yankees at Detroit Tigers

headlines.shortLinkText: Goldschmidt hits 2 HRs, Domínguez has go-ahead HR off Skubal in Yankees' 4-2 win over Tigers

headlines.description: — Braxton Ashcraft pitched six strong innings, batterymate Endy Roriguez drove in three runs and Ryan O’Hearn had three hits to help the Pittsburgh Pirates rout the Seattle Mariners 11-1 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ashcraft, Rodriguez, O'Hearn help Pirates rout AL West-leading Mariners 11-1

headlines.description: — Derek Hill hit a two-out, two-run pinch home run in the ninth inning to lift the Philadelphia Phillies past the Washington Nationals, 5-4 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Derek Hill hits 2-out, 2-run pinch homer in 9th to lift the Phillies past the Nationals, 5-4

events.name: Houston Astros at Toronto Blue Jays

headlines.description: — Joey Loperfido scored the tiebreaking run on Jeff Hoffman's errant pickoff throw in the eighth inning and the Houston Astros beat the Toronto Blue Jays 3-1 on Wednesday night for their sixth victory in eight games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Loperfido scores winning run on errant pickoff throw as Astros beat Blue Jays 3-1 for 6th win in 8

events.name: Chicago Cubs at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Dansby Swanson had a go-ahead RBI triple and four RBI to cap a monster doubleheader performance and help the Chicago Cubs sweep the reeling New York Mets with a 10-5 victory Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Danby Swanson caps monster doubleheader as Cubs sweep Mets

headlines.description: — Sal Stewart and Jose Trevino homered off Jacob Misiorowski, and Chase Burns pitched six strong innings as the Cincinnati Reds beat the Milwaukee Brewers 7-2 on Thursday afternoon.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chase Burns wins star-studded pitching matchup with Jacob Misiorowski as Reds beat Brewers 7-2

events.name: Los Angeles Dodgers at Minnesota Twins

headlines.description: — Mookie Betts backed Shohei Ohtani with his 300th career home run, three hits and slick defense as the Los Angeles Dodgers finished a...
headlines.shortLinkText: Betts hits his 300th homer in support of Ohtani as the Dodgers finish a sweep of the Twins

events.name: Arizona Diamondbacks at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — LuJames Groover and Ketel Marte hit back-to-back home runs to cap a six-run fourth inning that powered the Arizona Diamondbacks to a 9-4 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Groover, Marte hit back-to-back HRs to help Diamondbacks beat Cardinals 9-4

events.name: Atlanta Braves at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: — Ty France homered and JP Sears won his season debut for the San Diego Padres, who beat the NL East-leading Atlanta Braves 5-2 on Wednesday night for a three-game sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: France homers, Sears wins season debut as Padres beat Braves 5-2 for 3-game sweep

events.name: Athletics Athletics at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Rafael Devers hit a tying home run leading off the ninth and Victor Bericoto connected one out with a drive over the center-field fence, sending the San Francisco Giants to a 2-1 victory against the Athletics on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Devers, Bericoto homer in ninth inning, Giants rally past A's 2-1
